note: Proposed, not sealed. The operator, in a desk session, changing course on flatten phase F4. Withdraws decision 0252's four drafts. The record in full: willows-grove docs/design/one-script/flatten-2026-10-19.md (F-13 to F-15).

decisions.question: Do the python games move into the one script (decision 0252)?
decisions.commitment: No; 0252 is withdrawn. The games stay in safe-app-store. The move was undone before it was pushed.
decisions.why: The operator: "Before we go any farther, I think I want a change. I think it was more the randomness I wanted from the scripts, into the one script, than the games themselves." Then "1 undo the move".

decisions.question: Which of the games' randomness comes into the one script?
decisions.commitment: All of it: the table side of the stream, the dice source, the odds, the pools, catgrid's and bureau's generators and daily seed, and the 5e dice.

decisions.question: Do catgrid's and bureau's xorshift come in beside the stream, or stay with their games for the JS ports that replay them?
decisions.commitment: Both: named generators beside sha256-stream/v1 in the one script, and the games keep theirs; a parity test is the middle between each pair.
